crossrefs.text: I will sing of Your loving devotion and justice; to You, O LORD, I will sing praises.
Your faithfulness continues through all generations; You established the earth, and it endures.
Your loving devotion, O LORD, reaches to the heavens, Your faithfulness to the clouds.
O LORD God of Hosts, who is like You? O mighty LORD, Your faithfulness surrounds You.
They are new every morning; great is Your faithfulness!
The LORD swore an oath to David, a promise He will not revoke: “One of your descendants I will place on your throne.
Your loving devotion, O LORD, reaches to the heavens, Your faithfulness to the clouds.
But I will not withdraw My loving devotion from him, nor ever betray My faithfulness.
You stilled the roaring of the seas, the pounding of their waves, and the tumult of the nations.
For He spoke and raised a tempest that lifted the waves of the sea.
He calmed the storm to a whisper, and the waves of the sea were hushed.
Overwhelmed with fear, they asked one another, “Who is this, that even the wind and the sea obey Him?”
Suddenly a violent storm came up on the sea, so that the boat was engulfed by the waves; but Jesus was sleeping.
The men were amazed and asked, “What kind of man is this? Even the winds and the sea obey Him!”
Clouds and darkness surround Him; righteousness and justice are His throneʼs foundation.
Then Jesus got up and rebuked the wind and the sea. “Silence!” He commanded. “Be still!” And the wind died down, and it was perfectly calm.
“All the horns of the wicked I will cut off, but the horns of the righteous will be exalted.”
For it was not by their sword that they took the land; their arm did not bring them victory. It was by Your right hand, Your arm, and the light of Your face, because You favored them.
The nobles of the nations have assembled as the people of the God of Abraham; for the shields of the earth belong to God; He is highly exalted.
and be found in Him, not having my own righteousness from the law, but that which is through faith in Christ, the righteousness from God on the basis of faith.
Rejoice in the Lord always. I will say it again: Rejoice!
when His lamp shone above my head, and by His light I walked through the darkness,
Many ask, “Who can show us the good?” Shine the light of Your face upon us, O LORD.
But You have exalted my horn like that of a wild ox; with fine oil I have been anointed.
So Jesse sent for his youngest son and brought him in. He was ruddy, with beautiful eyes and a handsome appearance. And the LORD said, “Rise and anoint him, for he is the one.”
So Samuel took the horn of oil and anointed him in the presence of his brothers, and the Spirit of the LORD rushed upon David from that day forward. Then Samuel set out and went to Ramah.
The Son is the image of the invisible God, the firstborn over all creation.
And He is the head of the body, the church; He is the beginning and firstborn from among the dead, so that in all things He may have preeminence.
I will be his Father, and he will be My son. When he does wrong, I will discipline him with the rod of men and with the blows of the sons of men.

The Spirit of the Lord GOD is on Me, because the LORD has anointed Me to preach good news to the poor. He has sent Me to bind up the brokenhearted, to proclaim liberty to the captives and freedom to the prisoners,

to console the mourners in Zion— to give them a crown of beauty for ashes, the oil of joy for mourning, and a garment of praise for a spirit of despair. So they will be called oaks of righteousness, the planting of the LORD, that He may be glorified.

Now the LORD said to Samuel, “How long are you going to mourn for Saul, since I have rejected him as king over Israel? Fill your horn with oil and go. I am sending you to Jesse of Bethlehem, for I have selected from his sons a king for Myself.”
God is not a man, that He should lie, or a son of man, that He should change His mind. Does He speak and not act? Does He promise and not fulfill?
Heaven and earth will pass away, but My words will never pass away.
Every good and perfect gift is from above, coming down from the Father of the heavenly lights, with whom there is no change or shifting shadow.
“Because I, the LORD, do not change, you descendants of Jacob have not been destroyed.
For Godʼs gifts and His call are irrevocable.
For the sake of Your name do not despise us; do not disgrace Your glorious throne. Remember Your covenant with us; do not break it.
Yet in spite of this, when they are in the land of their enemies, I will not reject or despise them so as to destroy them and break My covenant with them; for I am the LORD their God.
“This is what the LORD says: If you can break My covenant with the day and My covenant with the night, so that day and night cease to occupy their appointed time,
May my accusers be clothed with disgrace; may they wear their shame like a robe.
All day long my disgrace is before me, and shame has covered my face,
Why have You broken down its walls, so that all who pass by pick its fruit?
The crown has fallen from our head. Woe to us, for we have sinned!
And I will set My face against you, so that you will be defeated by your enemies. Those who hate you will rule over you, and you will flee when no one pursues you.

And I will bring a sword against you to execute the vengeance of the covenant. Though you withdraw into your cities, I will send a plague among you, and you will be delivered into the hand of the enemy.

As for those of you who survive, I will send a faintness into their hearts in the lands of their enemies, so that even the sound of a windblown leaf will put them to flight. And they will flee as one flees the sword, and fall when no one pursues them. They will stumble over one another as before the sword, though no one is behind them. So you will not be able to stand against your enemies.
Do not go up, lest you be struck down by your enemies, because the LORD is not among you.
But God will redeem my life from Sheol, for He will surely take me to Himself. Selah
How long, O LORD? Will You be angry forever? Will Your jealousy burn like fire?
For the living know that they will die, but the dead know nothing. They have no further reward, because the memory of them is forgotten.
before the dust returns to the ground from which it came and the spirit returns to God who gave it.
By faith Enoch was taken up so that he did not see death: “He could not be found, because God had taken him away.” For before he was taken, he was commended as one who pleased God.
Yes, I know that You will bring me down to death, to the place appointed for all the living.
No man can possibly redeem his brother or pay his ransom to God.
that he should live on forever and not see decay.
